About.title: Our Story
About.description: EPR – Elly’s Party Rental was created with one purpose: helping families celebrate life’s special moments without the stress of planning everything on their own. As a family-owned business based in Lynn, Massachusetts, we take pride in providing clean equipment, honest pricing and dependable service. Every rental is prepared with care because we know your event matters. We don’t just rent party equipment—we help create memories that last a lifetime.
About.missionDesc: To bring safe, clean, and on-time fun to every home and celebration.
